compositionDeltasVsFullRun.harnessEvidence: The attempt-evidence summary now attributes model outcomes, model failures and the terminal cause to the primary Run by rootRunId and reports a delivery Run's terminal cause separately; the frozen record carries attemptBudgetMs and the wrapper's attemptTiming block.
compositionDeltasVsFullRun.concurrency: fh_max_parallel 8 -> 1. This is the environment fix: in run 36658268335 (and in the beta.37/beta.38 max runs) eight concurrent Docker image builds pulled image metadata from public.ecr.aws simultaneously and tripped its quota (429 toomanyrequests), killing datacurve cells before any model call. Serializing the rerun removes that contention. The 2026-09-27 precedent filled 3/3 beta.37 ECR cells at fh_max_parallel=5, so this run goes further than the precedent required.

environmentFix.rootCause: public.ecr.aws returns 429 `toomanyrequests: Data limit exceeded` on manifest metadata loads when many Docker image builds pull concurrently from the same GitHub-hosted runner pool. Observed in three independent max runs (beta.37, beta.38, beta.40), always on datacurve cells, always at 5-9 s, always before any model call.
environmentFix.remedyForThisRerun: Serial generation: fh_max_parallel=1, so exactly one task builds and runs at a time. Every other composition element is unchanged.
environmentFix.notRemediedHere: No change is made to the full-run default (8) or to the harness retry policy in this batch; those are separate decisions the user has not asked for.
